title: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students (MAECI)
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
field: All fields (also PhD, AFAM courses and Italian language courses)
description: Scholarships offered by the Italian government to foreign citizens and Italian citizens living abroad to support study, training and research at Italian institutions, promoting cultural cooperation and the internationalisation of Italy's academic system.
amount: EUR 900 per month, tuition fee waiver at public institutions, health insurance

title: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)
provider: MAECI, Italian Trade Agency (ICE) and Uni-Italia
field: Engineering and advanced technologies, architecture and design, economics and management
description: Scholarship and placement programme for master's students from selected partner countries, combining a fully funded English-taught master's at a participating Italian university with a mandatory internship at an Italian company.
amount: EUR 9,000 per year (EUR 1,000 x 9 months) plus full tuition fee waiver and a company internship

title: University of Bologna Study Grants for International Students
field: All fields (first- and second-cycle degree programmes)
description: Merit-based study grants for international students with a qualification obtained abroad enrolling in a bachelor's or master's programme at the University of Bologna.
amount: EUR 11,000 gross per year plus a total tuition fee waiver, renewable

title: Politecnico di Milano Merit-Based Scholarship
description: Merit scholarship for international students admitted to a laurea magistrale (master of science) programme, awarded automatically based on the evaluation score at admission.
amount: EUR 5,000 to EUR 10,000 per year, in some cases combined with a tuition fee waiver

title: Bocconi Merit and International Awards
field: Economics, management, finance, data science, political science
description: Merit awards for international students admitted to a bachelor's or master of science programme at Bocconi, covering part or all of tuition; a small number of full awards also include a contribution to living costs.
amount: Partial to full tuition fee waiver (EUR 13,000-16,000 per year), some with a living contribution

title: Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna PhD Scholarships
field: Biorobotics, economics and management, agricultural sciences, law, political science, data science
description: Fully funded doctoral scholarships at one of Italy's leading research schools, awarded by open competition to Italian and international candidates.
amount: Annual stipend of approximately EUR 16,900 plus free board and lodging and a research budget

title: Regional Right-to-Study Scholarships (DSU/EDISU)
provider: Regional right-to-study agencies (e.g. EDISU Piemonte, DSU Toscana, ER.GO)
description: Means-tested regional scholarships available to Italian and international students enrolled at a public university in that region, based on family income and assets as well as academic progress.
amount: Annual grant (EUR 2,000-7,000) plus housing and meal benefits for eligible students
